example.name: Inline Documentation
example.description:
Here is an example of the result from `dagger functions`:
``` Name Description hello Return a greeting. loud-hello Return a loud greeting. ```
Here is an example of the result from `dagger call hello --help`:
``` Return a greeting.
USAGE dagger call hello [arguments]
ARGUMENTS --greeting string The greeting to display [required] --name string Who to greet [required] ```
The following code snippet shows how to add documentation for an object and its fields in your Dagger module:
example.snippet:
from typing import Annotated
from dagger import Doc, object_type
@object_type class MyModule: """The object represents a single user of the system."""
name: Annotated[str, Doc("The name of the user.")] age: Annotated[str, Doc("The age of the user.")]
